title: The grandmaster in the bathroom (Igors Rausis, 2019)
post: The most embarrassing photo in chess history 🚽📱♟️ #chess #history #story #cheating

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: This is the most embarrassing photo in chess history.
phrases.say: [mischievously] This is the most embarrassing photo... in chess history.

phrases.text: The man on that toilet, Igors Rausis, was 58. And one of the top 100 players in the world.
phrases.say: The man on that toilet... Igors Rausis... was fifty-eight. And one of the top one hundred players in the world.

phrases.text: His rating kept climbing, and nobody could explain how.
phrases.say: His rating kept climbing... and nobody could explain how.

phrases.text: His wins came against players hundreds of points weaker. And FIDE started watching.
phrases.say: [mischievously] His wins came against players hundreds of points weaker... and FIDE started watching.

phrases.text: July 2019, Strasbourg. In the middle of a game, he goes to the bathroom.
phrases.say: July twenty nineteen, Strasbourg. In the middle of a game... he goes to the bathroom.

phrases.text: In that toilet, they find a phone.
phrases.say: [whispers] In that toilet... they find... a phone.

phrases.text: And this photo goes around the world: a chess program, on an iPhone 4. In 2019.
phrases.say: And this photo goes around the world. A chess program... on an iPhone four. [laughs] In twenty nineteen.

phrases.text: He signs: the phone is his. "I simply lost my mind."
phrases.say: [serious] He signs. The phone is his. [sighs] 'I simply lost my mind.'

phrases.text: But a year later, it gets crazier.
phrases.say: [mischievously] But a year later... it gets crazier.

phrases.text: A tiny tournament in Latvia. A new player signs up: Isa Kasimi.
phrases.say: A tiny tournament in Latvia. A new player signs up... Isa Kasimi.

phrases.text: New name. Same face. Half the room recognized him.
phrases.say: [laughs] New name. Same face. Half the room recognized him.

phrases.text: His words: "You can change your name, but you cannot hide your face."
phrases.say: His words... 'You can change your name... but you cannot hide your face.'

phrases.text: So, how many years would you ban him? Comment a number.
phrases.say: [curious] So... how many years would you ban him? Comment a number.
